4446.title: Tasks project-default fails for secondary-host-only project
4446.rootCauseOneLine: Server fixes project-default selection to the primary host before finding a source, yielding 404 for a secondary-only project.
4446.proposedFix: Select a usable project source host with deterministic fallback while preserving explicit-host policy.
4446.caveats: Two clean actual Tasks/server database fixtures; synthetic hosts/RPC and waiting environment provider, no real remote execution.
